title: Affine restriction of the proper-support tensor input data and direct image
statement: Let f:X→S be of finite presentation [def-pc-morphism-conventions], E perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and G a bounded finitely presented complex termwise flat over S and with proper support [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. For any affine open U⊆S, pull back along j:Spec Γ(U,O)→U→S. The resulting X′→Spec Γ(U,O) is of finite presentation, E′ is perfect, and G′ has the same termwise and boundedness properties. Moreover Lι_U*Rf*(E tensor^L G) is isomorphic to L(U.isoSpec.hom)*Rf′*(E′ tensor^L G′) [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No Noetherian model is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 36.30.1, affine reduction and Noetherian approximation paragraph

proof.text: Construct j as U.isoSpec.inv followed by the open inclusion; choose the canonical pullback scheme, its projections, E′ as derived pullback, and G′ as ordinary termwise tensor pullback. Morphism finite-presentation and qcqs instances survive base change. Apply preservation of perfectness to E and properSupport_tensorPullback_properties to every term of G. The additive tensor-pullback functor sends all zero terms outside the original finite interval to zero terms.

Perfectness gives quasi-coherent cohomology of E, and finite presentation gives quasi-coherence of each G term. Apply cartesian_tensor_data_comparison to the canonical square with identity identifications of the pulled factors.

Extract the proved composition isomorphisms of derived pullback. Pull the preceding comparison back along U.isoSpec.hom. Rewrite U.isoSpec.hom followed by j as U.ι using the scheme isomorphism identity; the inverse composition comparison identifies the left object with Lι_U*Rf*(E tensor^L G).

theorem properSupport_affine_tensor_restriction
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : Scheme.IsPerfect X E)
    (G : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    [∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation]
    (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFlatOver f)
    (hGproper : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.X n))
    (U : S.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (f' : X' ⟶ Spec Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation f' ∧ QuasiCompact f' ∧ QuasiSeparated f' ∧
      ∃ (hf' : LocallyOfFiniteType f') (E' : schemeDerivedCategory X'),
        Scheme.IsPerfect X' E' ∧
        ∃ G' : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℤ,
          (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G'.X n)) ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, (G'.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, (G'.X n).IsFlatOver f') ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, @Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver _ _ f' hf' (G'.X n)) ∧
          Nonempty ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj
              ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) ≅
            (derivedPullback U.toScheme.isoSpec.hom).obj
              ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj (E' ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G')))
